shared_elements: elaborately curled hair and beard rendered as rows of tight curls
long fringed/pleated robe with parallel drapery lines
figure holding an object in outstretched hand
low relief with figures on a plain ground, single register
justification: Both show striding bearded men in strict profile with stacked-curl beards, tall headgear, long fringed robes rendered in fine parallel folds, and an object carried in the extended hand, all in shallow relief on a blank ground — a very consistent set of figural conventions. The decisive differences in content are B's huge multi-register wings and stylised palmette tree, which have no counterpart in A's procession of wingless courtiers touching one another and carrying vessels.
